t: Dökkálfar and Ljósálfar - Wikipedia
s: 3 weeks ago - In Norse mythology, Dökkálfar ("Dark Elves") and Ljósálfar ("Light Elves") are two contrasting types of elves; the dark elves dwell within the earth and have a dark complexion, while the light elves live in Álfheimr, and are "fairer than the sun to look at".

t: The Light Elves (Ljósálfar) of Norse Mythology
s: February 28, 2024 - Given that the Ljósálfar are benign, described as being full of light, ruled by the Vanir god of love and fertility and that they are to be called upon for healing, we might infer that their realm is also a place of benevolence, light and abundance. The bright elves, unlike dwarves or dark elves, have their own annual sacrifice or celebration known as the ‘Álfablót’. The important Álfablót ritual is carried out on a local level, at the time of harvest and giving thanks for the bounty of the gods through nature.
